answer: The willow register is checked at draw time, opal lists the eligible set, and onyx seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 52 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker burns for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 52 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 267 account operation therefore ties up 6 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
